method_inheritance: Every stage consumes hashed PASS handoffs and inherits the exact Quantum ESPRESSO version, PBE functional, Cu and Na UPF hashes, componentwise maximum cutoffs, smearing, converged slab dimensions, vacuum, k mesh, and electrostatic convention.
scientific_separation: Computed electronic barriers, partial-Hessian prefactors, model rates, experimental quantities, friction, and linewidth are distinct fields and are never blended.

grid.inplane_kmeshes: four meshes derived from the selected cubic bulk mesh

stage_2_clean_slab_handoff.execution: sixteen matrix jobs, one registered layer-vacuum pair per job and four in-plane k meshes per job

stage_3_clean_relaxation.constraints: outer two Cu layer pairs relax along z; inner or central layers remain fixed; x and y are fixed to preserve the registered surface lattice
pass_checks: ionic convergence reported by Quantum ESPRESSO
relaxed layer pairs remain mirror symmetric within 0.01 A
top two interlayer relaxations are recorded
final SCF reproduces the relaxed energy

stage_4_na_pseudopotential.archive: same pinned SSSP v2 PBE-efficiency archive used for Cu
stage_4_na_pseudopotential.selection: unique UPF whose parsed element attribute is Na; ambiguity gives HOLD
stage_4_na_pseudopotential.mixed_cutoffs: componentwise maximum of selected Cu settings and registered Na recommendations
required_provenance: isolated Na reference energy and output hash

stage_5_adsorption_screening.coverage_model: one Na adatom in a 4x4 primitive Cu(001) surface supercell
stage_5_adsorption_screening.electrostatics: single-sided adsorption with ESM vacuum-slab-vacuum treatment for every site
stage_5_adsorption_screening.relaxation: Na and inherited movable Cu z coordinates relax; frozen Cu coordinates remain fixed
stage_5_adsorption_screening.site_pass_rule: all nine starts converge, site collapse is retained, and the global minimum must classify as fourfold hollow for the registered diffusion route

checks: endpoint A energy is reproduced by an independent final SCF within 0.001 eV
translated endpoint B relaxes and reproduces endpoint A within 0.001 eV
endpoint separation equals one primitive surface translation within geometric tolerance
coordinate, input, output, and handoff hashes are recorded

stage_7_path_convergence.initial_path: nearest-neighbor hollow-to-hollow interpolation through the intervening bridge region
stage_7_path_convergence.pass_rule: select the smallest image count whose forward barrier differs by <= 0.005 eV from every larger registered image count and whose endpoint energies remain verified

pass_checks: endpoint energies reproduce verified endpoints within 0.001 eV
all image coordinates and outputs are hashed

stage_9_saddle_verification.method: Na-only partial Hessian at the minimum and saddle plus unstable-mode downhill connectivity
hessian_requirements: minimum has three positive Na partial-Hessian eigenvalues
saddle has exactly one negative Na partial-Hessian eigenvalue
unstable eigenvector aligns with the hollow-to-hollow path by >= 0.70
eigenvalues from 0.02 and 0.04 A displacements agree within 20 percent

connectivity.rule: relaxations from plus and minus unstable-mode displacements reach distinct registered endpoint basins

stage_9_saddle_verification.prefactor: Na-only partial-Hessian Vineyard prefactor with a separate finite-displacement convergence check
stage_9_saddle_verification.limitation: substrate vibrational determinants are not included

stage_10_barrier_coordinate.primary: electronic forward and reverse barriers from verified endpoints and CI-NEB saddle
uncertainty_components: half the registered image-count barrier range
stage_10_barrier_coordinate.separation_rule: electronic, zero-point, thermal, friction, linewidth, and experimental quantities remain separate fields
stage_10_barrier_coordinate.null_rule: zero-point, thermal free-energy, friction, and linewidth fields remain null unless independently calculated or supported at the same state point

stage_11_atlas_admission.experimental_rule: public experimental candidates remain HOLD unless an exact coverage-temperature rate table is available
stage_11_atlas_admission.non_blending_rule: computed and experimental values occupy distinct columns and are never substituted for one another

required_outputs: SHA-256 raw-output manifest verified against retained files
compact raw calculation artifacts with restart scratch removed
stage_12_integration.computational_pass_rule: stages 1 through 11 validate with exact schemas, PASS states, resolvable handoff hashes, and a raw-output manifest that matches every retained raw file
stage_12_integration.experimental_boundary: experimental-only HOLD fields do not invalidate computational closure but remain explicitly unresolved
